summary: Kanzhun Limited, a Cayman Islands company listed in Hong Kong, filed a Form 6-K with a Next Day Disclosure Return detailing routine changes in issued shares. Activities included exercises of share options under employee share schemes, totaling roughly 2.1 million new shares at prices between USD 0.5 and USD 1.8795, and a series of share repurchases for cancellation from May to June 2026 at approximately USD 6.68-7.25 per share. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is present; the filing is standard reporting of equity issuer changes under Hong Kong listing rules.
